svg.aria-label: ULTRON: A personal AI system that runs locally. 19 Rust and Python processes share one authenticated WebSocket bus, each its own failure domain. Every event lands in a hash-chained audit log. Built for: Personal project. Key result: 337 tests. Built with: Rust, Python, Ollama.
